test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six friends, A, B, C, D, E, and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

C is the immediate neighbour of A and E. F is second to the right of C and third to the left of A. If B is second to the left of C, where is D seated?

options.text: Fourth to the right of C
Second to the left of A
Second to the left of B
Third to the right of E

solution:
Given: Six friends, A, B, C, D, E, and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) F is second to the right of C and third to the left of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67bacbdd0433aca5721ed5554cf2c0f8ed313d08a730f8bd612e45bbe483a246.png] 

2) C is the immediate neighbour of A and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f00aa74a7d702473d4436fd4380485ef08327fb0c7b740044f76057ac8fa442.png] 

3) B is second to the left of C.

After positioning B only position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/288ad6b5f4d699be22ad23a2420ff326c2cf1b7f9591ed82c4b1d8510c95b8fc.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D is second to the left of A.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
